name: ghost-reader
title: Ghost Reader (虚影读取器)
author: INFIcer
description: Adds a custom constant-combinator style entity (Ghost Reader) that reads every ghost inside the construction range of the logistics network it belongs to (entity ghosts, tile ghosts, upgrade requests) and outputs, as per-item circuit signals, the count of each. 添加自定义恒压器式实体「虚影读取器」：读取其所在物流网络建设范围内的所有虚影（建筑/地格/升级虚影），按物品把数量输出为电路信号。
